build_anchor_head: build an AnchorHead instance with custom num_classes, in_channels, and anchor generator config for object detection
run_forward_single: run forward_single on a single scale level feature tensor to get cls_score and bbox_pred outputs
test_get_bboxes: test get_bboxes to transform multi-level cls_scores and bbox_preds into final detection results with NMS
review_loss_single: review loss_single to understand how classification and regression losses are computed for a single scale level
summarize_get_targets: summarize get_targets to understand how anchor classification and regression targets are computed across multiple images
